create_macro_handler_mixin: create a MacroHandlerMixin that processes LaTeX macros and converts them to DoclingDocument nodes
build_custom_macros_extraction: build custom macro extraction from LaTeX preamble nodes with argument count parsing and depth limiting
extract_preamble_metadata: extract preamble metadata from LaTeX document nodes including title and other metadata macros
expand_custom_macro_invocation: expand custom macro invocations with argument extraction and rendering from parsed LaTeX nodes
process_macro_includegraphics: process \includegraphics LaTeX macros to load images and create DoclingDocument picture nodes
